wrong-200-asks.defect: asks a person about a refund of exactly the automatic limit

wrong-500-denied.defect: denies a refund of exactly the upper limit

wrong-missing-amount-allowed.defect: lets a refund with no amount through

wrong-coerces-amount.defect: turns a text or a boolean amount into a number

wrong-gates-every-tool.defect: applies the refund limits to a tool that is not a refund

wrong-cents-kept.defect: leaves amount_cents beside the new amount

wrong-rewrites-plain-text.defect: answers a replacement for output that is not json

wrong-not-idempotent.defect: reports a change for output that is already readable

wrong-no-matcher.defect: registers the refund gate for every tool

wrong-no-timeout.defect: registers the hooks without a timeout

wrong-exit-one.defect: blocks with exit code 1, which does not block

wrong-bad-input-passes.defect: lets a call through when the hook input is not json

wrong-settings-no-timeout.defect: writes the settings hook without a timeout
